title: Build Desk project settings (.builddesk.json)
description: Checked in beside an Xcode project, or anywhere above it up to the repository root, so everyone opens the project in Build Desk with the same setup. Every key is optional.

favoriteSchemes.description: Schemes listed first, in this order, in a group of their own. Names that the project does not have are ignored.

hiddenSchemes.description: Schemes left out of the list. A name must match in full; * stands for any run of characters, as in "*Tests".

defaultScheme.description: The scheme selected when a person opens the project for the first time. After that, their own last choice is used.

defaultConfiguration.description: The build configuration selected when a person opens the project for the first time. After that, their own last choice is used.

release.description: The project's release commands, which give it a Release mode. Each is an argument list run from the folder that holds this file. Described in docs/release-contract.md.

status.description: Prints where each app stands. Read-only.

plan.description: Prints what an action would do. Changes nothing.

run.description: Does what a confirmed plan described.

checks.description: Runs the go or no-go gates and prints each result. Read-only.

store.description: Prints live state from the store: per build its cloud run, testing state and tester groups. Read-only.

artifact.description: Saves a build's installable file to a folder and prints where it is.

build.description: Prints one build in full: its notes, and the notes testers see for it now. Read-only.
